sheets.name: README
rows: Traceability view for one regulation-to-SHACL generation run.
Generation is frozen before RDF execution; no ship graph or hidden expected outcome is used here.
events.jsonl is append-only; CSV and Excel sheets are derived views.
Static validation passed and the semantic validator accepted the candidate.
No verified canonical term was available; the generator was not allowed to invent one.
Accepted shapes await the separate bulk evaluator.

sheets.name: RUNS
rows: Preserve the prior instructions on ship ownership, applicability, comparison directions, units, and the tolerance-based derived-value check. The UIWL selection remains semantically incorrect: the query merely compares the single ship-level displacementAtUpperIceWaterline with the single ship-level waterlineDisplacement, leaves ?uiwl unused, and neither binds the selected value to a specific UIWL nor proves that no other supplied UIWL has greater displacement. The current maxCount 1 structure also cannot represent multiple UIWL candidates and their displacements. Provide the required canonical cross-owner/path structure (without relocating or duplicating waterlineDisplacement from its authoritative ship owner), then encode selection of the greatest-displacement UIWL and use that selected ship value as the forward-draught formula operand.
